segments.oily: Oily-skin reviewers generally describe the serum as lightweight and non-greasy, with several saying it balances oiliness and helps acne-prone skin, though one reports it caused irritating bumps.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including several with very dry or winter-dry skin, report the most consistent hydration gains, less flaking and improved plumpness, with one exception finding it insufficiently hydrating.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report it balances an oily forehead with a drier or sensitive lower face, keeping both areas comfortable.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no irritation and fragrance-free comfort, but a minority describe breakouts or reactivity after use.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her late thirties reports plumper, younger-looking skin and reduced appearance of fine lines after two weeks.

concerns.aging: The one reviewer citing fine lines reports a plumper, younger look after two weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers across skin types report noticeably improved hydration and plumpness, some within days; one reviewer felt it did not hydrate enough or leave the expected glow.
concerns.redness: A reviewer with rosacea reports the serum helped hydration during flare periods; no other redness-specific feedback is given.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers using it alongside actives (retinol, masks, cold weather) report it helped restore comfort and reduce dryness-related irritation.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports fewer dry patches ('no longer have dry spots') after nightly use; no other spot-specific comments appear.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no breakouts and even improved balance, but three reviewers explicitly report new breakouts or being 'broken out' after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report the serum does not add greasiness and can reduce dehydration-driven oiliness, though one found it sticky rather than mattifying.

aspects.libelle: Glass bottle breaks or is fragile

extraits.texte: I have sensitive skin, therefore I wanted to slowly introduce this product to my skincare. After using it the second time I saw red breakouts all over my face. I stopped using it and after about a week my skin was back to normal.

This serum was sticky, and didn't even take long before it broke me. I have oily skin was looking for a product that help with hydration and reduce my dehydration-induced oiliness. Unfortunately, this product didn't work out. Not only that, but upon returning the item, I had to pay for shipping and wouldn't be getting back the original shipping cost in my return. I was also told that if a discount code is used, products are ineligible for return, but that they'd made an "exception".

I am 38 years old and just starting to see some fine lines. I have also been struggling with VERY dry, dehydrated, and sensitive skin. Ive been using this for 2 weeks now and wow- huge difference! My skin is so hydrated and I definitely think that it looks plumper and younger. Big fan of this stuff. Oh, and I LOVE that its fragrance free. No irritation whatsoever!

I just finished my first bottle of the quadruple hyaluronic acid serum and I can honestly say that I loved it! The formulation is smooth and soothing making it glide right over your skin as you apply it. It absorbs quickly but more slowly than the hyaluronic acid serum that I tried from The Ordinary. I believe this is due to the formulation and I liked the difference because I didn't feel rushed to quickly get to my next step to avoid my skin starting to dry. I have combination skin with a very oily forehead and an easily irritated and dry naso-labial area. The lower face sensitivity is new post-pregnancy and my skin was drying to the point of constant flaking while my forehead was a pure oil slick. I used this serum on my lower face and the niacinamide gel cream on my forehead... Miracles. That's it. My lower face is now holding moisture all day and no more embarrassing flakes! Love this serum.

I loved this serum. I have sensitive, acne prone (hormonal) skin that waivers between combo-dry. Heavy moisturizers are not the best option for my given my acne, so I am always on the hunt for a hydrating serum to help my dry skin areas. This is better than the more expensive ones I've tried (skin ceuticals, drunk elephant). I actually noticed a difference in my skin's plumpness and overall hydration, and it didn't irritate or trigger any acne or sensitivity at all. I'm now trying out the essence and love that too. This one is best if you want something with a little more kick to it though.

I got this the first days of February and got me through the coldest days of winter without my skin being flaky, I have rosacea so sometimes my skin is good and sometimes really bad, this has helped a lot with my hydration during this time.

I am slowly getting into this. In the past hyaluronic have irritated my skin. I am oily and sensitive and I tend to get bumps from it. So far so good. I do not use this every day and when I do it's at night. It has a nice texture though
